goalSummary: Persistent `P:OFF` when proxy is confirmed running

facts.why: Runbook must identify the env vars used as the authoritative proxy-active signal
The toggle mechanism that unsets env vars but leaves the process running must be named
Legacy port-based detection method must be documented as subordinate to env var check
The statusline renderer file controlling badge state must be identified
Confirmation: faded/black badge is transient and self-resolves without intervention
